headlines.text: Back on this day in 2024, Will Ospreay vs. Brian Cage clashed for the AEW International Title, appearing on Collision, rated 7.30 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. It was the 40th time the AEW International Title had been on the line, a real landmark for that championship. In the longest match of the night, Ospreay survived a deadlift superplex and a near-fall F10 before finishing Cage with the Hidden Blade to retain the International Championship.
Looking back to 2022, when it was Cassidy, Romero & Taylor's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.82 ? a solid showing.
That Wednesday in 2022, Silas Young stepped through the curtain for the first time against Adam Page, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.80.

secondaries.text: On a Saturday in 2024, back when The Varsity Athletes (Trio) left that name behind for good, stepping out as The Premier Athletes (Trio) after 3 matches under the old identity, on Collision.
Looking back to 2022, when Hiroshi Tanahashi announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.24.
On a Saturday in 2024, back when AEW welcomed Ultimo Guerrero for the first time against Kazuchika Okada, appearing on Collision, rated 3.60.
